List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries:  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and
Forests; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development;
Ocean Development; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—20

Agricultural research and extension
system
*21. DR. MANMOHAN SINGH : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made
any assessment of the health of
agricultural research and extension system
and its ability to cope up with the
challenges that Indian agriculture faces;
and
(b) if so, what are the findings thereof?
Promotion of sports
*22. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
‘SURYA’: Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a committee has been set up
on Government—Industry co-operation for
promotion of sports;
(b) if so, whether various sports
federations are also associated with this
committee; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Growth target of agricultural sector
*23. SHRI SOLIPETA
RAMACHANDRA REDDY: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) the rate of growth targeted and
achieved in agricultural sector during the
last three years, year-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that this sector
performed below the target during the
same period;
(c) if so, the details thereof,
togetherwith the reasons therefor;
(d) the details of target set for the year
2001-02 and likely achievements thereof;
and
(e) the steps taken to improve the
performance of this sector?
Purchase norms in Jaipur region of
KVS
†*24. SHRI D.P. YADAV: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a definite
procedural norm for purchases in

violation of procedure in purchase of

against them by the Sangathan, while

Departmental enquiries in KVS
†*25. SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
departmental enquiry has normally to be
completed within six months, as per
Central Civil Service Rules, 1965;
(b) if so, the details of departmental
enquiries in Kendriya Vidyalaya
Sangathan which are pending/incomplete
for the past one, two, three, four or more
years;
(c) the details of such delay, enquiry-
wise;
(d) the details of provisions for action
against officers responsible for such delays;
and
(e) the details of officers against whom
such action has been taken/is to be
taken?
Water purification plant for the
Railways
*26. PROF. M. SANKARALINGA M:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that he has
announced recently setting up of water
purification plant and an independent
power plant for the Railways;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal;
and
(c) how Government would go about
in implementing the same?
Chilli prices in Karnataka
*27. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that chilli prices
have fallen steeply in the country; if so,
what are the reasons therefor;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
there is no Minimum Support Price
mechanism for chillies; if so, what are the
details of steps proposed to be taken in that
direction;
(c) the total production of chillies in
Karnataka during the last three years and
the rates of procurement, year-wise; and
(d) whether Government propose for
Market Intervention Scheme in
Karnataka; if so, the details thereof?
Agricultural subsidies for farmers
*28. SHRI AIMADUDDIN
AHMAD KHAN (DURRU):
SHRI C.M. IBRAHIM:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of agricultural subsidies
extended, in different forms, to farmers

Achievements of CIL
4383. SHRI BALWANT SINGH
RAMOOWALIA:
SHRIMATI SHABANA
AZMI:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state what are the
Coal India Limited's achievements with
respect to the targets fixed in terms of net
profit, coal production, off take, productivity
and capacity augmentation, during the last
three years till date (year-wise)?
Infrastructural status on
coal sector
4384. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it was ever considered to
award infrastructural status on coal sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
any decision has been taken in this regard;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Survey regarding effect of coal mines
dust on human health
4385. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Western
Coalfields Ltd. recently conducted a survey
of certain areas surrounding the Chandrapur
district of Maharashtra State to investigate
effect of coal mines dust on human health;
(b) if so,  the findings thereof; and
(c) what remedial measures have been
taken in case it is harmful to health?
Setting up of a coal mine at
Jayankondam, Tamil Nadu
4386. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to set up a
coal mine at Jayankondam in Tamil Nadu
considering its ample potential;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

958
WIN2\SESSION\688RS 958
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Community development works by
CIL and BCCL
4387. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether CIL and BCCL have
undertaken any community development
works in coal producing States like Bihar,
Jharkhand and Orissa;
(b) if so, the details of the districts where
such works have been undertaken,
State-wise;
(c) the nature of developmental works
so undertaken; and
(d) the amount spent on these
developmental works, district-wise, so far?
FDI in the mining sector
4388. SHRI C.P. THIRUNAVU-
KKARASU: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has chalked out
any plan to boost the flow of foreign direct
investment in the mining sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to set
up exclusive Regulating Authority for the
country's mining industry; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Accidents in coal mines
†4389. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of mine-wise/year-wise
accidents occurred in coal mines in the
country during the last three years;
(b) the number of workers killed in the
above accidents;
(c) whether Government have given any
compensation to the workers who lost their
lives during the above period; if so, the
number of the workers to whom
compensation was given and the amount of
compensation given to them;
(d) whether some of the cases related to
the compensation to the workers killed in
accidents are still pending for disposal; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Statutory benefits to contract
labourers in MCL
4390. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) how many labourers are engaged in
Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), Ib
Valley and Talcher by various contractors;
(b) whether these contract labourers are
getting minimum statutory benefits such as
Provident Fund, ESI etc.;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the fresh steps taken by Government
to ensure minimum statutory benefits to the
labourers engaged at various coalfields
across the country?
Amount spent by MCL on
advertisements
4391. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the total money spent by Mahanadi
Coalfields Limited (MCL) on advertisement,
press and publicity during the last three
years, year-wise;
